description: Any Google Docs API batchUpdate: text, styles, bullets, tables (insert, merge, row and column, cell style), images by URL, headers, footers, footnotes, page and section setup, named ranges, tabs, replace all text, and the rest; local images through `images`. One atomic batch, checked against the API's schema before anything is sent (a wrong field is refused with the nearest right name). Requests apply in order, each to the document as the ones before left it: work from the end of the document backwards so earlier indices stay valid. A batch that names an index needs expected_revision (refused if the document changed) or target_revision (Docs carries the positions over later edits), from get_document or find_in_document. In a tab other than the first, put tabId in each location and range. Returns the new revisionId and the replies that carry ids or counts, by request position.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

document_id.description: The document's id, or its URL.

expected_revision.description: The revisionId these requests were computed from; the batch is refused if the document is no longer at it.

content_base64.description: Instead of path, from a script only: never typed. Needs sha256.

path.description: The image file, in the server's file roots (where upload_file reads).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source: required with content_base64, checked with path.

images.description: Local PNG, JPEG or GIF images by name; use "image:<name>" as the image URL in a request (insertInlineImage.uri, createImage.url, replaceImage, replaceAllShapesWithImage.imageUrl). Each is uploaded to Drive, shared by link only while the batch runs, then unshared and trashed.

requests.description: docs batchUpdate requests, applied in order, all or none: each an object with ONE request kind, e.g. {"insertText": {"location": {"index": 1}, "text": "Hello\n"}}. Kinds: createFooter, deleteFooter, createHeader, updateParagraphStyle, insertTableColumn, insertPageBreak, deleteCommentReply, updateDropdownDefinitionProperties, updateDropdownProperties, deleteTableRow, replaceNamedRangeContent, updateTableRowStyle, unmergeTableCells, updateDocumentStyle, createNamedRange, updateCommentPost, updateTableCellStyle, rejectSuggestion, deleteNamedRange, deleteTab, replaceImage, updateNamedStyle, insertText, insertPerson, deleteHeader, mergeTableCells, addDocumentTab, insertDate, insertTableRow, createDropdownDefinition, insertSectionBreak, updateTextStyle, updateDocumentTabProperties, insertTable, deleteTableColumn, acceptSuggestion, insertDropdown, deleteComment, insertInlineImage, insertComment, deleteContentRange, updateTableColumnProperties, createFootnote, insertRichLink, deleteDropdownDefinition, createParagraphBullets, updateSectionStyle, replaceAllText, deleteSuggestion, pinTableHeaderRows, deleteParagraphBullets, addCommentReply, deletePositionedObject. editors_api_reference names each kind's fields.

target_revision.description: Instead: apply as of this revisionId, with Docs moving the positions over edits made since.

name: batch_update_document
title: Apply Docs API requests
